# Security

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do **not** open a public issue for a security problem.

- Use GitHub's private reporting: [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/KeyStarr/SoloStone/security/advisories/new), or
- write to KirillLoves@proton.me.

Say what you found, which version, and how to reproduce it. We will read it and answer when we can. This is a
small project run by volunteers, so we cannot promise a fixed time.

## What counts

Things we want to hear about:

- a way to make the launcher or setup run code with more rights than they should have, or change files outside the
  folders they own;
- a way around the update signature check, or to make the updater install something that was not signed;
- a way to make the offline copy reach the internet, or to bypass the firewall check;
- a way to damage your Hearthstone installation, Battle.net or Blizzard account data;
- a way to corrupt or leak your saves.

Not security problems (use a normal issue): game rules bugs, card text, crashes, and Windows SmartScreen or antivirus
warnings on the unsigned installer (see [INSTALL.md](../docs/INSTALL.md)).

## Supported versions

Only the latest release.

## Notices from rights holders

If you represent a rights holder and have a notice about this project, write to KirillLoves@proton.me and name the
file, text or release you mean. We read it and act promptly.
